scope: Generated arithmetic identities, area-accounting identities and the ROM full-array sweep floor only.
A passing audit is not evidence for ROM macro timing, array read bandwidth at a leading node, NoC timing, package, power delivery, yield, or model accuracy.
The two validation gates are reported separately and are the only checks against a shipping part.

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

designs.name: Qwen3-8B/ROM-N5-native-SRAMKV-array-pipeline-x3

compute_density_ops_s_mm2[bf16].note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 bf16 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

compute_density_ops_s_mm2[fp32].note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 fp32 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

compute_density_ops_s_mm2[fp4].note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 fp4 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

compute_density_ops_s_mm2[fp8].note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 fp8 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

compute_density_ops_s_mm2[w4a8].note: sqrt(fp8_roof * fp4_roof) / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). 4-bit-weight by 8-bit-activation datapath, bracketed below by the published w8a8 roof and above by the published w4a4 roof on the same die; both endpoints are reported separately

compute_efficiency.note: fraction of the peak tensor roof a real decode kernel sustains, covering pipeline bubbles, tail effects and non-tensor interleave
compute_efficiency.source: carried over from src/opentallas/schema.py ArchitectureProfile default

cooling_limit_w_per_mm2.note: A100 SXM dissipates 400 W over an 826 mm2 die, 0.484 W/mm2, rounded to 0.50. Cross-checks: Taalas HC1 at a reported 250 W over 815 mm2 is 0.31 W/mm2, and a 15-23 kW wafer over 46,225 mm2 is 0.32-0.50 W/mm2.

rom_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (sram_bitcell_um2 * rom_cell_ratio / rom_array_efficiency). N5 mask-ROM array capacity density in bits/mm2
rom_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no fabricated leading-node mask-ROM bitcell has been published for this program ; no published mask-ROM macro floorplan at a leading node

rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.note: rom_capacity_density_bytes_mm2 / (rom_read_bandwidth_density * rom_read_efficiency). time to read every stored weight once; independent of model size, batch and expert coverage, so it is a hard per-token ceiling for a ROM design
rom_full_array_sweep_time_s.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no fabricated leading-node mask-ROM bitcell has been published for this program ; no published mask-ROM macro floorplan at a leading node ; https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no fabricated array to measure

rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_ops_s / ops_per_weight * weight_bits / 8 / macro_area) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N5 mask-ROM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; anchor density 6.000e+10 B/s/mm2 scaled by 6.048x
rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N5 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N5 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N5 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

N5 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_ops_s / ops_per_weight * weight_bits / 8 / macro_area) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N5 mask-ROM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; anchor density 6.000e+10 B/s/mm2 scaled by 6.048x
rom_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N5 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N5 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

rom_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N5 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_density_bits_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bandwidth_density_bytes_s_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). sram_read_bandwidth_efficiency.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

designs.sizing_rule: smallest device count within 2% of the best per-user latency at batch 1, bounded at 4x the minimum feasible count. SRAM-KV designs are sized at batch 1 because SRAM is silicon area; HBM-KV designs are provisioned for batch 256 for both KV capacity and enough KV bandwidth to keep KV off the critical path ahead of the ROM sweep, capped by the die-edge beachfront a shipping GPU achieves

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

bf16.note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 bf16 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

fp32.note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 fp32 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

fp4.note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 fp4 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

fp8.note: anchor_format_roof_ops_s / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). N5 fp8 compute density in ops/s/mm2, derived from the published a100_sxm_80gb dense roof and die area

w4a8.note: sqrt(fp8_roof * fp4_roof) / anchor_die_area_mm2 * (target_logic_density / anchor_logic_density). 4-bit-weight by 8-bit-activation datapath, bracketed below by the published w8a8 roof and above by the published w4a4 roof on the same die; both endpoints are reported separately

compute.note: fraction of the peak tensor roof a real decode kernel sustains, covering pipeline bubbles, tail effects and non-tensor interleave
compute.source: carried over from src/opentallas/schema.py ArchitectureProfile default

hbm_bandwidth.note: applied to both weight and KV traffic on an HBM device
hbm_bandwidth.source: commonly measured STREAM-class fraction of HBM peak on datacentre GPUs

hbm_capacity.note: fraction of physical HBM available to checkpoint and KV after runtime workspace, allocator and safety reserve
hbm_capacity.source: carried over from src/opentallas/schema.py ArchitectureProfile default

rom_read_bandwidth.note: Fraction of the ROM array's peak sweep rate sustained in practice. A mask-ROM sweep is the most regular access pattern available -- a compile-time-fixed linear walk of the whole array with no arbitration, no conflicts and no refresh -- so 0.75 is a conservative charge and 0.90-1.00 is arguable. The study reports the underated ceiling alongside it because this derate moves the ROM answer directly.

sram_read_bandwidth.note: fraction of the SRAM array's peak read rate sustained by a real gather pattern

stage_balance.note: penalty applied to a multi-device pipeline for imperfect layer balance across devices
stage_balance.source: no measured layer-to-device partition for the modelled designs

phy_area_mm2_per_stack.source: no vendor-published HBM PHY macro area

stack_bandwidth_bytes_s.note: B200 SXM delivers 8 TB/s across eight HBM3E stacks: 8 TB/s / 8. Micron publishes over 1.2 TB/s per HBM3E stack at full pin speed (https://www.micron.com/products/memory/hbm/hbm3e), so 1.0 TB/s is the rate a shipping system actually clocks and is the conservative choice.

stack_beachfront_mm.note: 11 mm x 11 mm HBM3E package plus routing keep-out

stack_capacity_bytes.note: B200 SXM ships 180 GB across eight HBM3E stacks: 180 GB / 8. Micron's published HBM3E 12-high part is 36 GB per stack (https://www.micron.com/about/blog/applications/ai/micron-continues-memory-industry-leadership-with-hbm3e-12-high-36gb), so this is the SHIPPING-SYSTEM figure rather than the densest available die stack. Deriving it from the reference GPU keeps both sides of the iso-area comparison on identical memory technology, which is the point.

hop_latency_s.note: InfiniBand/Ethernet class scale-out hop. Not measured.

bytes_s.note: NVLink 4/5 class unidirectional payload rate per GPU, taken as half of the quoted 1.8 TB/s bidirectional

hop_latency_s.note: NVLink point-to-point sits around 1 us for small messages. A real all-reduce is two phases through a switch plus launch and synchronisation overhead, so 1.5 us is optimistic; 3-10 us is common in practice. Sweep upward, never downward.
300 ns per organic/silicon-interposer chiplet hop. Not measured.

bytes_s.note: Cerebras WSE-3 aggregate fabric bandwidth, 26.75 PB/s, used as the on-wafer payload-serialisation ceiling

hop_latency_s.note: 100 ns per on-wafer reticle-to-reticle hop; a stitched on-wafer link has no SerDes, no packet framing and no switch, so it is well under a package hop. Not measured.

rom_capacity_bits_per_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (sram_bitcell_um2 * rom_cell_ratio / rom_array_efficiency). N5 mask-ROM array capacity density in bits/mm2
rom_capacity_bits_per_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no fabricated leading-node mask-ROM bitcell has been published for this program ; no published mask-ROM macro floorplan at a leading node

rom_read_bytes_s_per_mm2.note: (anchor_ops_s / ops_per_weight * weight_bits / 8 / macro_area) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N5 mask-ROM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; anchor density 6.000e+10 B/s/mm2 scaled by 6.048x
rom_read_bytes_s_per_mm2.source: https://doi.org/10.1145/3489517.3530576 ; counting convention: one multiply plus one add is two operations ; https://en.wikichip.org/wiki/28_nm_lithography_process ; https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/

technology_derivations.rom_sweep_note: The ROM full-array sweep time is rom_capacity_density divided by rom_read_bandwidth_density. Both scale with the same published bitcell-area ratio under this derivation, so the sweep time -- and hence the ROM path's hard per-token ceiling -- is the SAME at every node. Process scaling buys a ROM design capacity, not per-token speed. No clock-frequency bonus is credited, which makes this the conservative reading.

sram_capacity_bits_per_mm2.note: 1e6 um2/mm2 / (bitcell_um2 / array_efficiency). N5 6T high-density SRAM array capacity density in bits/mm2
sram_capacity_bits_per_mm2.source: https://semiwiki.com/semiconductor-manufacturers/tsmc/283487-tsmcs-5nm-0-021um2-sram-cell-using-euv-and-high-mobility-channel-with-write-assist-at-isscc2020/ ; no vendor macro floorplan published for the target arrays

sram_read_bytes_s_per_mm2.note: (anchor_sram_read_bytes_s / anchor_die_area_mm2) * (anchor_bitcell_um2 / target_bitcell_um2). N5 SRAM array read-bandwidth density in bytes/s/mm2; the anchor rate is charged against WHOLE-die area and then applied only to array area, which is conservative

metrics.hop_semantics: no inter-partition event on one token's critical path
metrics.latency_rule: hop and collective latency is added to the critical path, never overlapped; per-user latency is the full serial traversal and aggregate = batch x per-user rate
metrics.overlap_rule: weights and KV share one memory system: their times add

validation_gates.gate_policy: The Taalas HC1 gate is evaluated with the achievable derates because 17,000 tok/s is a product figure. The A100 gate is evaluated on the ideal roofline with every derate at 1.0 because it is pure arithmetic: published HBM bandwidth divided by checkpoint bytes.

area_split_mm2.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest

area_split_per_device.policy: balanced: ROM sized to stored weights, SRAM sized to resident KV, graded fixed fractions for overhead and interconnect, compute takes the rest
